title: Ben Mara

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the old Tanchuma, beginning of Behar, saying: “Although Rabbi Chanina said,” etc. Tanchuma Buber reads Ben Mama, and Seder HaDorot reads Ben Mada.[^1]

notes.text: The Buber text at Behar 1 has Ben Mama introducing Rabbi Chanina’s statement. Ben Mara in the heading and Ben Mada attributed to Seder HaDorot remain Hyman’s reported variants; the latter work has not been independently collated here.
